Device-specific OpenXR extensions may require a vendor plugin in addition to built-in OpenXR; consult its support matrix and distinguish toolkits from engine runtime APIs.
VisualShaderNodeDotProduct calculates dot(a,b); it measures projection/alignment, not vector normalization, so connect compatible inputs and normalize only when the effect requires it.
JointLimitation3D is a Resource base attached to ChainIK3D joints to constrain bone rotation; choose its concrete cone limitation for actual constraints.
LinearSceneDepth provides linear-space depth from DEPTH_TEXTURE for fragment shaders; do not use it as a vertex-stage source or mistake raw projected depth for distance.
VSeparator visually separates horizontally arranged controls and usually draws a StyleBoxLine; it does not itself reorganize layout or create an interactive splitter.
Debug attachment needs get-task-allow entitlement; enabling it prevents notarization. Use a dedicated debug artifact rather than re-signing the production release.
OpenXRIPBindingModifier applies to an interaction profile; its concrete D-pad modifier belongs to the binding configuration rather than gameplay transform code.
Texture is the Resource base for 2D, 3D and layered textures; select a concrete texture type and distinguish CPU Image data from GPU-facing texture resources.
ResourceImporterShaderFile imports native GLSL into RDShaderFile for RenderingDevice; it does not import .gdshader ShaderMaterial code.
UVPolarCoord converts UVs to polar coordinates with scale, zoom and repeat inputs for swirl effects; verify texture seams and UV range visually.
VisualShaderNodeOutput is the shader graph output block; effects must connect the appropriate output value ports rather than leaving a calculated branch unused.

Check --help for the actual build because unknown options are silently ignored. --check-only parses the specified script, --import waits for editor resource import, and --quit-after counts iterations. Export paths resolve relative to the project, require an existing output directory and matching templates. Headless uses Dummy audio and cannot prove visual/audio output. Recovery mode disables tool scripts, editor plugins and native addons; script automation requires SceneTree/MainLoop and explicit exit.
TransformCompose builds an affine transform from four vec3 inputs; verify the resulting basis and translation against shader matrix conventions rather than assuming CPU row/column layout.
Create IntervalTweener through Tween.tween_interval(), not IntervalTweener.new(); an idle delay must participate in a valid Tween sequence.
ParticleBoxEmitter emits within specified box extents; verify start-position distribution with fixed seeds rather than only shader compilation.
The default advanced text server supports BiDi and contextual shaping through HarfBuzz, ICU and Graphite; choosing a simpler server changes complex-script rendering capability.
VectorCompose assembles vec2/vec3/vec4 from scalar ports; the 4D representation is not automatically a normalized rotation quaternion.
Particle output ports vary by start/process/collision function and custom-data enablement; connect effects in the intended stage and check motion over frames.
VSplitContainer accepts two controls and arranges them vertically with a draggable divisor; it is an interactive splitter rather than a decorative separator.
VisualShaderNodeIf compares float inputs using an explicit tolerance and selects one of three vec3 outputs for equal, greater and lesser; test all three regions.
OuterProduct multiplies a column vector by a row vector and returns a matrix; it is distinct from the scalar result of a dot product.
Low-pass attenuates frequencies above cutoff_hz on the audio bus, useful for muffling; verify bus routing and audible output separately from resource creation.

Choose the target architecture and export templates explicitly; ARM64 is not an x64 executable. Embedded PCK has an approximately 3.89 GB combined limit. Signing needs the tool and certificate, and environment export overrides can supersede preset options.

Recovery mode disables tool scripts, editor plugins, GDExtension, automatic scene restoration and game execution; diagnose the crash in a preserved project copy and return to normal mode for runtime verification. Importing a project is different from installing editor add-ons.

HDR requires native Wayland, not X11/Xwayland, and older GNOME can block it. Automatic display fallback means requested Wayland is not evidence of effective driver. The page suggests --display-server, but CLI documentation and the verified 4.7.2 --help expose --display-driver; use the actual binary flag.

RPCs require matching node paths, annotations and declaration checksums on both peers, but matching does not validate payload arity or trust. Inspect create_client/server errors, transport/platform and transfer channels. Ready acknowledgements need sender deduplication and a session epoch; the tutorial counter can be inflated by repeated calls. Dedicated servers are not lobby players. The authentication snippet misspells auth_timeout and uses an invalid client callback: 4.7.2 ClassDB confirms auth_timeout/auth_callback, and source calls the callback with two arguments. Do not copy that snippet. GDScript parser registration confirms @rpc default transfer is reliable in this pinned build.
IntConstant emits an int-valued shader constant defaulting to zero; set the constant property for integer operations rather than relying on float coercion.
Low-shelf adjusts gain below cutoff_hz instead of simply cutting high frequencies; use it for bass balance with bus routing and audible comparison.
Feature profiles hide editor UI and classes but do not remove runtime support or optimize exports. The article is marked outdated, so verify UI/API before scripting profile changes.
A Texture2DArrayParameter exposes a texture collection uniform; sample a selected layer with Texture2DArray rather than treating it as a normal 2D texture.
High-pass attenuates frequencies below cutoff_hz and can leave low-end room for bass and impact effects; contrast with low-shelf gain and verify the actual listening result.

The asset page exposes author, license, source, changelog and reviews. Browsing/downloading needs no login; uploading, reviewing and flagging are separate account actions. Re-submit searches after changing filters.
PlaceholderCubemap intentionally has no image data for dedicated server stripping or missing classes; it is not a usable shader/rendering replacement and UV operations are not guaranteed.
Texture2DArrayRD wraps an array texture created on RenderingDevice for materials; prefer Texture2DArray unless low-level compute/render integration requires the RD resource.

Native mobile VR provides basic side-by-side 3DOF using device sensors and is not actively maintained. Initialize the interface before enabling viewport XR and calibrate distortion/device dimensions in centimeters.

GlobalExpression emits declarations above generated shader functions; put shared functions, uniforms and varyings there, and invoke functions in ordinary Expression nodes rather than executing fragment work globally.
OfflineMultiplayerPeer behaves as a connected server with no remote peers. is_server()==true and peer ID 1 do not prove a live network server is listening.

Project warning settings can promote selected warnings to parse errors. Use targeted warning_ignore or scoped ignore/restore for understood cases rather than disabling warning enforcement to make validation pass.
Hotspot sampling needs a binary with symbols and the correct project process/arguments. Attach after warmup to exclude startup and inspect per-thread utilization and heavy flame-graph stacks.
VisualShaderNodeConstant is abstract; choose a concrete boolean, scalar, vector or transform constant that matches the graph port type.
Blend3 blends the base toward one of two animations according to negative/positive amount, normally in [-1,1]; use Add3 for intended amplification rather than accidental extrapolation.
Editor UI, script editor, embedding and CLI workflows are distinct from platform-specific Android/Web/XR editor capabilities. Feature profiles hide UI, not engine support.
PointMesh requires material point-size enablement or POINT_SIZE. It renders constant-size screen rectangles and ignores normal billboard/grow/cull vertex controls; verify it on the actual backend.
Godot separates scene, server and driver/platform layers, with core types and main-loop initialization crossing layers. A server implementation detail is not automatically a script-exposed operation.
Add3 chooses negative/positive ports by amount sign but always adds using absolute weight; the negative port does not subtract the base animation, and values beyond one amplify it.
Dedicated-server exports or missing engine classes can yield dimension-only PlaceholderTexture2DArray resources; do not treat them as sampleable rendering textures.
Place manual probes before baking and rebake after changes. They light GeometryInstance3D objects with GI_MODE_DYNAMIC; probe placement after a bake alone has no effect.
ColorRect supplies a solid filled Control rectangle through color; use a Panel and its style for a border-only frame.
FloatConstant emits a shader float with default zero; select it for scalar graph inputs rather than integer or vector constants.

Imported .ccube is an internal cache format. Disk lossless/lossy compression does not reduce GPU memory. The prose says four modes but lists five including Basis Universal and inconsistently says only VRAM Compressed saves GPU memory despite describing Basis as GPU compressed; verify actual import mode rather than repeat that exclusion.

Experimental FBXState inherits GLTFState. allow_geometry_helper_nodes records use of auxiliary nodes that preserve source pivots/transforms; account for those nodes when comparing imported hierarchies.

BoxOccluder3D stores a cuboid size in world units for OccluderInstance3D culling; it is an occlusion resource, not a physics collision shape.
Vec2Constant emits a Vector2-valued graph input defaulting to zero; match vector port dimensionality before connecting it.

Project Manager lists standalone Templates whereas the project editor excludes them. Inspect the installer file selection and red conflict reasons before installing; imported local archives follow the same workflow, and editor search updates live.

SphereShape3D radius defaults to 0.5 and diameter is twice radius. It is documented as cheaper to test than box/capsule/cylinder; prefer it when the collision approximation fits and measure the target scene.
Texture3D performs volume texture lookup; its texture property is used only when inherited Sample3D.source selects SOURCE_TEXTURE. Check source selection when an assigned texture appears ignored.

Web-only JavaScriptObject wraps interfaces, constructed objects and callbacks. Keep a reference to create_callback results; callback receives an argument array rather than the original function signature.
Save reusable shader snippets as .gdshaderinc and include by path. A snippet need not compile independently; code returns authored snippet text rather than expanded generated shader code.
A GDScript resource instantiates with new(...); set_script extends an existing compatible base-class object. Built-in language functions belong to @GDScript rather than this resource API.

Command Palette can send InputEventShortcut through input/shortcut_input/unhandled_input. Viewport.push_input can inject it; its represented Shortcut matches this event regardless of an ordinary keyboard-event comparison.
BoxShape3D size contains full width/height/depth, not half extents. Documentation ranks sphere cheaper and capsule/cylinder costlier; use suitable approximations and profile actual physics workload.
TransformConstant supplies a Transform3D graph input defaulting to identity, preserving basis and translation instead of representing a single vector.

Experimental Compositor stores the ordered array of custom CompositorEffect resources applied to viewports using it; configuring this resource alone does not establish backend support or successful GPU execution.
Deprecated VisualShaderNodeComment is a compatibility alias behaving as Frame; description retains old data but has no current function. Use VisualShaderNodeFrame for new graphs.
AnimationRootNode represents a complete animation output, usable at AnimationTree.tree_root or nested in other roots; ordinary blend operations are not interchangeable tree roots.

XR asymmetric per-eye projection can place a screen-centered vignette off-center in headset view. The recipe subdivides a camera quad and offsets inner vertices with projection while retaining edge coverage; screen texture copies add substantial GPU load. Headset visual verification remains required.

Windows export automatically converts PNG/WebP/SVG to ICO since 4.1. Custom ICO must contain all six default sizes 16 through 256 to replace every variant; distinguish native taskbar icon from export executable icon and inspect a fresh export/icon cache.

Gradle creates android/build and builds fresh Java templates while native .so remains precompiled. AAB/external SDK integrations need this path; Android-editor builds require GABE since 4.6. Underscore-prefixed folders are omitted from APK assets but underscore-prefixed filenames are not.
AnimationNodeSync.sync controls whether zero-weight blended animations keep advancing. Enable it for phase continuity when reintroducing an input, otherwise inactive inputs stop advancing.

PanelContainer lays children inside the theme panel StyleBox area and supplies its background. Its mouse_filter override is STOP by default, so inspect input capture when a decorative wrapper blocks interaction.

PCK encryption needs custom templates compiled with SCRIPT_AES256_ENCRYPTION_KEY and matching export GODOT_SCRIPT_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Empty include filters encrypt nothing; wrong runtime key yields file-corrupt errors. Embedded-key obfuscation is not a secret-storage guarantee; custom engine build is outside promised execution.
SpringBoneCollisionSphere3D belongs to SpringBoneSimulator3D rather than general rigid-body physics. radius defaults 0.1; inside=true confines the joint within the sphere instead of excluding it.

Choose Linux architecture for actual target hardware and matched templates; rv64/ppc64/loongarch64 lack official export templates. Distribution combines a template executable and PCK; export encryption env overrides editor settings. Linux runtime/device results remain untested on this Windows host.

_process follows rendered-frame cadence; _physics_process uses configured fixed ticks (default 60). Integrate displacement with delta but keep per-second velocity APIs unscaled; run collision-body movement in physics callback, and test at varying frame rates.
Expression code is injected into vertex/fragment/light function scope with custom ports. Functions, uniforms, varyings and global constants must instead use GlobalExpression.

StreamPeerTLS wraps connections and HTTP clients use HTTPS. A configured PEM bundle overrides OS trust; self-signed trust still enforces CN/SAN hostname validation. Package public trust certificates only and keep private keys server-side.

Android-only JavaObject wraps JNI objects returned by Java methods; has_java_method checks name availability and get_java_class returns its type. It is distinct from Web JavaScriptObject and does nothing on other platforms.
HScrollBar maps minimum left and maximum right. Theme padding_top/bottom separates track and grabber; horizontal padding is configured through scroll StyleBox left/right content margins.
Texture2DRD exposes a RenderingDevice-created texture via texture_rd_rid for materials/meshes. It is low-level integration; prefer ordinary Texture2D for imported content.

Percent-name lookup is cached and scoped to a scene, not global across instantiated scenes. Cross into the instance then resolve its unique name, including %Sword/%Hilt; groups serve broader discovery and find_child incurs traversal cost.

This pinned FAQ distinguishes new Asset Store from Asset Library assets that were not automatically migrated. Functional beta submissions are allowed, inert feature buttons are not. Version uploads have a 1GB limit and AI contributions require disclosure; recheck live policy before any future submission.

PlaceholderTexture2D preserves pixel size for stripped dedicated-server exports or unavailable subclasses; it intentionally lacks a reliable rendering texture. Default size is one pixel and must not be mistaken for original image content.

Touch gestures cannot be emulated by ordinary mouse emulation. position is viewport-relative except inside Control._gui_input where it is control-local; test actual multitouch hardware and avoid mixing spaces.

Experimental spatial persistence query data returns an entity-indexed XrSpatialPersistenceStateEXT integer and persistent UUID string. Query snapshot success alone does not establish that every entity is persisted.
Vec2Parameter emits uniform vec2. Its configured default_value is used only when default_value_enabled is true; check that flag when material defaults appear ignored.
Vec4Parameter emits uniform vec4 with a zero vector default and a separate disabled-by-default default_value_enabled flag. Preserve four-component semantics when routing graph parameters.
BitMap imports produce boolean click masks. Black-and-white uses HSV value and alpha mode uses opacity; only pixels strictly greater than threshold are enabled, so equality remains disabled.

RenderingDevice pipeline specialization constants have shader-specific constant_id and bool/int/float values only. They specialize shader variants and branching; vectors and other Variant types are invalid.
UIntParameter represents unsigned shader uniform despite a Godot int property. External values override defaults; custom default requires default_value_enabled or zero applies.

UIntFunc supports unsigned unary negate and bitwise NOT. FUNC_MAX is an enum-size sentinel, not an operation; do not interpret unsigned negation as ordinary signed-number negation.

Set the tree parameter seek_request to seconds for a one-shot seek; the next process frame resets it to -1. explicit_elapse handles intervening keys/root-motion calculations and nearest discrete keys.

AudioListener2D must be in SceneTree before make_current works. It replaces the viewport hearing point and disables the previous current listener; with none active, hearing uses screen center.

OpenXR haptic amplitude is 0..1, duration is nanoseconds with -1 requesting runtime minimum, frequency is Hz with zero requesting device-optimal frequency. Device response must be checked in the real XR runtime.

Tracy capture requires matched profiler/client versions and an instrumented engine/template build; include symbols for sampling and prefer production-like release templates. Connect before launch or stored events can grow RAM. This optional engine-build analysis is not ordinary script API execution.

WorldBoundaryShape2D defines an infinite colliding half-plane. Nonzero normal points toward non-colliding space; distance is plane-equation d and physical distance is abs(d)/normal.length(), not necessarily d for nonunit normals.

Sampling estimates hot stacks whereas tracing shows instrumented events only. Useful native attribution needs unstripped symbols and production-like builds; official standard binaries lack symbols. Android provides Perfetto templates, an exception to the page generalization that tracing always requires self-building.

RenderingDevice attachment format combines data format, sample count enum and texture usage flags. Default enum integers are not literal sample counts; match attachments with pipeline/framebuffer requirements.

Register custom nonnegative numeric Callable metrics with category/name; editor queries roughly once per second while manual get_custom_monitor can query more and works in release exports. Example steady-state 20 spawns/s with 2.5s lifetime predicts about 50 entities; assert behavior rather than graph appearance only.

Groups decouple tag-based discovery and broadcasts. Global versus Scene group UI labels are organizational: identically named groups are the same runtime group, not isolated namespaces. Define stable names and receiver method contracts.

project.godot defines res:// root and Godot paths use slash delimiters. Treat packaged res:// as readonly and persist to user://; resource moves should repair dependencies through FileSystem dock and case-exact paths must survive Linux/Android/PCK exports. The blanket claim of no metadata is outdated relative to import/UID files.
ParticleAccelerator belongs in particle shader process and connects to Velocity output. Linear, radial and tangential modes differ by velocity/center/radius direction; MODE_MAX is a size sentinel.

Godot uses XR as common server/interface scope, VR for immersive virtual scenes and AR for overlay into physical surroundings. Passthrough can implement AR or selectively reveal VR peripherals. Handheld AR currently needs platform-specific plugins rather than assumed portable OpenXR.

StreamPeerUDS provides same-machine filesystem socket IPC on Unix-like hosts and is unsupported on Windows. bind fixes a client source socket path; connect_to_host selects the destination path, not a TCP hostname.

TorusMesh exposes inner/outer radius plus rings and ring_segments. These subdivision controls affect geometry cost; choose silhouette-appropriate values rather than carrying defaults across every detail level.

SceneTree.paused stops physics servers and processing according to inherited ProcessMode, but connected signal handlers still run. A WhenPaused menu can open from a button signal and close itself; Always processing alone does not reactivate physics. Test pause/resume animation/audio and input.

Pseudolocalization tests glyph fallback, text expansion, untranslated strings and RTL layout before translations arrive. Runtime property edits need TranslationServer.reload_pseudolocalization; preserve formatting placeholders with skip_placeholders and verify actual layout beyond transformed text.

SkinReference owns a RenderingServer skeleton RID for a Skin/mesh context. Skeleton3D does not correspond one-to-one: no mesh can mean no server RID, different skins can yield multiple RIDs, and shared Skin across skeleton nodes yields multiple references.

GridContainer arranges Control children only with a fixed configured column count and derived rows; resizing does not auto-change columns. For responsive grids update columns intentionally and theme h/v separation, then verify minimum sizes.

OpenXRStructureBase chains native API structures through next and exposes XrStructureType. _get_header is undocumented; do not invent a safe GDScript pointer recipe without version-matched native binding contracts.

Engine Compilation Configuration Editor writes .gdbuild profiles but does not shrink stock exports. Custom template compilation is required; Detect overwrites manual selections and cannot reliably see runtime scripts, expressions, extension use or external PCK features.

Project SVG editor icons should enable Scale with Editor Scale and Convert Colors with Editor Theme then reimport. Native engine icons require exact class-name filenames and rebuilt engine; palette mapping affects light-theme contrast. Keep editable originals when optimization strips guides.

Experimental OpenXRSpatialQueryResultData must be the first requested snapshot component. get_capacity returns retrieved entity count; use per-index entity ID and tracking state before applying transforms or persistence assumptions.

TCPServer returns StreamPeerTCP connections and listen has explicit interface scope: star binds IPv4/IPv6, loopback binds local only. Check listen Error and Android INTERNET permission; accept availability/stop lifecycle belong to inherited SocketServer.

_enter_tree can repeat and precedes children; _ready runs after children and ordinarily once, while _exit_tree occurs after child exit callbacks. Gameplay events belong in _unhandled_input when UI should consume first. Verify request_ready exceptions in Node before adopting lifecycle assumptions.

Experimental snapshot plane alignment data distinguishes upward-horizontal, downward-horizontal, vertical and arbitrary orientation per parent entity index; do not classify all horizontal surfaces as floors.

PackedDataContainer is deprecated in favor of var_to_bytes/store_var plus explicit byte/file compression. Legacy pack accepts untyped Array/Dictionary only, overwrites on repeat calls and nested containers return PackedDataContainerRef.

Android XR builds require Android export setup and XR Mode OpenXR. Page conflicts mandatory vendor-loader wording with 4.6+ optional vendor plugin note; inspect runtime/plugin/store requirements. Per-device presets permit vendor-specific settings. Compatibility recommendation and actual headset deployment need device validation.

Android crash symbols must match exact exported template build and CPU ABI. Official template symbols are separately downloadable; custom builds generate their own separate symbols. ndk-stack needs the initial asterisk marker and correct ABI directory, preserving build-to-symbol provenance.

Marked-outdated Web editor documentation limits execution to Compatibility and lists missing C#/GDExtension/debugger/export capabilities. Projects persist in IndexedDB only within /home/web_user; download source ZIP backups and use native editor for export. Verify current deployed editor before promising capabilities.

GLTFTextureSampler preserves glTF sampling: magnification/minification filters and S(horizontal)/T(vertical) wrap modes. Integer values are glTF enums, not arbitrary Godot texture flags; inspect imported sampling when runtime appearance differs.

Web templates default without GDExtension; dlink_enabled produces separate dynamic-link templates and extension binaries must match. Source builds require Emscripten/SCons; thread and JavaScriptBridge feature options differ. The naming prose repeats release where commands correctly show debug. Engine self-build remains optional advanced boundary.

macOS distribution behavior depends on signing, notarization and quarantine state; path randomization breaks relative app-directory dependencies. Use supported signing/notarization and test a downloaded artifact on macOS. Old System Preferences screenshots and global Gatekeeper-disable advice are not safe/current delivery defaults.

MeshTexture draws through a mesh with 2D vertices and a base texture, using image_size for reference. Region drawing and changing flags are unsupported; it cannot replace a normal texture in all sprite/atlas operations.

StereoEnhance pan_pullout controls side gain with zero downmixing mono. surround and time_pullout_ms work together; alone they pan left or delay right. Validate mono compatibility and actual audible changes rather than asserting widening from property values.

Step evaluates step(edge,x), returning one at equality and zero below edge. Vector-scalar modes use scalar edge; vec4-scalar prose mistakenly describes a/b/weight mix ports, so verify generated shader before using that text.

Experimental persistence config goes into create_spatial_context next chain and must contain at least one persistence-context RID created through anchor capability. Empty config is invalid; preserve explicit context ownership/lifecycle.

EditorFileDialog follows editor native-dialog settings rather than FileDialog.use_native_dialog; popup explicitly since default invisible. Deprecated add_side_menu is a no-op and overwrite warning should use inherited overwrite_warning_enabled.

XRTracker names are runtime-dependent unique identifiers. Reserved left_hand/right_hand controller names differ from /user/hand_tracker/left or right skeletal hand trackers; discover supported tracker type rather than assuming interchangeability.

XR editor supports Android XR/Quest device development with permission-dependent filesystem, install, audio and scene access. GDExtension requires Android binaries, C# and external script editors are unavailable, Forward+ has documented performance limits. Device/OS requirements remain documented-not-tested.

AudioEffectEQ band gains are dB and indexed against get_band_count. Choose EQ6/10/21 or a custom equalizer for mix/speaker correction; assert routing and gain persistence but verify tonal quality by listening on target devices.

Emit a spawn request to the world owner so bullets do not inherit player transform or require parent hierarchy. The sample passes local rotation/position and assumes equal coordinate space; production composition should define world-space payload and convert after parenting, then test Player independently and under transformed parents.

Read class description/dependencies plus inherited APIs before using method/property tables; qualifiers and signal-emission conditions govern behavior. Table defaults and setter/getter names help Callable binding but are not proof of platform support or successful runtime effects.
ImageTexture3D represents a volume for density/LUT/vector-field/SDF uses. create fixes dimensions/format/mipmaps and update must match that layout; update cannot resize or change pixel format.

World2D provides canvas, physics-space and navigation-map RIDs for nodes registered in that world. With threaded physics, direct_space_state queries belong in main-thread _physics_process, not arbitrary worker callbacks.

CapsuleMesh height includes both hemispherical ends and is constrained to at least twice radius; changing invalid dimensions adjusts properties. Read back resulting values and align collision dimensions rather than assuming every assigned value is preserved.

AudioStreamPlaybackResampled mixes source Hz to AudioServer mix rate using cubic interpolation. Native AudioFrame pointer virtual mixing is an extension/native contract; begin_resample resets history, and mixed-frame count must reflect actual output.

Room-scale tracking needs PlayerBody-style origin/body coordination rather than blindly nesting XR under CharacterBody3D. XR Tools direct movement, snap turning and teleport are controller subscenes; align floor collision top with visual floor and verify physical movement plus chosen comfort options on headset.

Configure inheritance/path before popup and consume script_created for the resulting Script. Sample creates a Window without adding it to SceneTree; a usable plugin must parent/manage/free the dialog and handle cancellation rather than copy the sample verbatim.

ProjectSettings.set_setting often changes stored configuration only because settings are read at startup; runtime changes should use Engine/DisplayServer/etc equivalent API. Read effective runtime state and feature overrides, save deliberate persistent settings and reopen to verify.

Android XR thread scheduling hints require OS thread IDs such as gettid, not Thread.get_id. Zero identifies current thread; choose critical-main versus background-worker and CPU versus renderer roles and check returned success on supported runtime.

Android editor supports project creation/export but needs suitable device graphics and permission scope. Native extensions need Android binaries; no C#/external script editor, PiP play window has no input, and Android Go limits filesystem access. Verify device workflow instead of claiming native-desktop equivalence.

OpenXRFutureExtension is intended for native extensions, despite illustrative GDScript await code. Check is_active after XR initialization; register only real XrFutureEXT handles and inspect status after completed because completion is not inherently success.

GPU validation layers add overhead and require installed layers plus --gpu-validation; --gpu-abort stops at validation errors. macOS needs dynamically linked use_volk custom builds, iOS/Web unsupported; Android debug builds need ABI-matched layer libraries and logcat. Do not count enabling a flag as verified GPU correctness.

OggPacketSequence stores page granule positions, raw packets and codec-supplied sampling rate; zero default sampling_rate is not valid duration metadata. granule_positions getter returns a copy, so modify then assign back. get_length is seconds.

Output filtering can hide errors and is not failure detection. push_error/warning feed Debugger Errors while printraw only reaches stdout/file logs; debug stack helpers are limited to editor/debug exports. Capture process logs and assert behavior independently of panel appearance.

Godot 4.7 provides official Android Perfetto Gradle-source and non-Gradle APK templates. Trace godot events for performance; godot_scripting is deliberately slow full scripting trace for understanding hitches. Fix duration/buffer/category, collect on device, and distinguish overhead from baseline.
Billboard output must connect to Model View Matrix, not vertex position. keep_scale=false discards mesh scale by default; explicitly enable it when instance sizing must remain visible.

PacketPeerExtension exposes required packet-count/max-size virtuals and native buffer-pointer get/put operations but lacks method semantics. Keep as on-demand native index; verify pointer lifetime/error contract in binding/source before implementing a custom transport.

Deletion trades reload cost for released state, hiding preserves processing/collision unless separately disabled, and detaching preserves memory but removes tree lifecycle/groups. Root children beyond current_scene persist across swaps. The page claims immediate scene deletion; verify SceneTree actual deferred replacement semantics before awaiting or dereferencing.

GDExtension resource represents a native shared library managed by GDExtensionManager, not a script-language resource. Initialization levels distinguish core/servers/scene/editor; editor initialization is absent at runtime, and library-open alone does not validate registered behavior.

OccluderPolygon2D supplies LightOccluder2D geometry. closed versus open outlines and cull direction change shadow behavior; polygon getter returns a copied packed array, so assign edited data back and verify light from multiple sides.

Spring-bone capsule height includes hemispheres while mid_height excludes them and wraps full height. height/radius auto-adjust to valid dimensions; inside confines joints. This is simulator-specific collision, not a rigid-body collider.

ConvexPolygonShape2D is solid and appropriate for dynamic concave approximation via multiple hulls, unlike hollow concave geometry. points must already form a hull; use set_point_cloud to compute it, then assign copied getter data back. More shapes cost more than primitives.

Inspector distinguishes in-memory resources from saved disk resources. Duplicated nodes share subresources until Make Sub-Resources Unique; edit/save resource deliberately and reload to verify persistence. Copy raw property paths for API use instead of localized display labels.

ColorFunc grayscale uses maximum RGB channel, not perceptual luminance; HSV and sepia operations have explicit formulas. Linear/sRGB conversion differs on Compatibility and negative inputs can behave poorly. Check encoding to avoid double conversion and validate backend output.

Layered texture images must match first image dimensions/format/mipmap flag. Texture2DArray needs at least one, Cubemap exactly six ordered X+/X-/Y+/Y-/Z+/Z-, CubemapArray multiples of six. update_layer matches layout and synchronizes with drawing; assert create/save errors and reload.

Manual StaticBody2D movement teleports without sweeping bodies in its path; use AnimatableBody2D for a moving platform. Constant linear/angular velocity affects touching bodies without translating/rotating the static surface itself. Physics-timed animation is needed for collision transforms.

VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D relies on render culling and visible=true, and is_on_screen remains false until a draw pass after instantiation. show_rect only controls editor visualization. Headless launch cannot establish on-screen activation behavior.

Lerp weight represents remaining-distance fraction, not speed. Repeated delta*speed lerp is frame-rate dependent; exponential weight 1-exp(-speed*delta) smooths consistently. Clamp finite-travel t to prevent extrapolation, and transform interpolation assumes compatible scale.

Experimental AprilTag configuration dictionary must be selected before spatial-context creation; default 36H11 differs from 16H5/25H9/36H10 code sets. Enabled-components getter is valid only after context creation. Test actual marker/runtime support.

Read-only standardized humanoid profile specifies 56 bones in Body/Face/LeftHand/RightHand, Root root bone and Hips scale base. Build BoneMap against this hierarchy for retargeting instead of changing immutable profile parameters.

StaticBody3D manual transforms teleport and do not sweep or push intervening bodies; use AnimatableBody3D when desired. Constant velocity simulates moving contact surface without moving geometry, and angular velocity is a Vector3 unlike 2D scalar.

ColorOp implements explicit RGB blend formulas such as screen/difference/min/max/overlay. Dodge denominator 1-b and burn denominator b can become zero; choose/guard input ranges and inspect generated shader instead of assuming normalized HDR-safe output.

Node paths use actual names and @onready resolves just before ready. PackedScene loading and instantiation are separate; new nodes need parenting and queue_free releases subtree later, leaving references temporarily alive. For generated saved scenes add owner contract absent from introductory sample.

ConcavePolygonShape3D is hollow triangle geometry intended for static level collision; fast small bodies can pass into its empty interior. Use primitive/convex decomposition for dynamic objects and test backface normals; faces array consists of triangle triples.

CryptoKey public_only defaults false for load/save/string serialization, so an unspecified flag can include private material. Use explicit public-only export and is_public_only checks; keep private TLS keys on server and check load/save Error.

HashingContext streams start/update/finish rather than loading an entire asset. Example misses FileAccess null and Error checks, and C# casts remaining file size to int before limiting chunk, unsafe for large files. Validate short reads/progress and compare known SHA256 fixtures.

RenderSceneDataExtension implements native camera transform/projection, UBO RID and multiview count/eye/projection getters. These are extension rendering contracts requiring matching buffer layout/lifetime, not a high-level script camera recipe.

Experimental custom animation-node processing accepts eight float64 playback fields and must return all six float32 time-info fields. Honor test_only and distinguish looping/infinite remaining time; array shape correctness alone does not prove blending behavior.

Shortcut can contain multiple events but get_as_text shows only first valid one. matches_event does not alone filter key release/echo; check pressed/non-echo then mark viewport input handled. CommandOrControlAutoremap preserves platform shortcut semantics.

CSV localization supports 4.6+ ?plural and ?context but requires manual tr_n/tr for those cases. Quote embedded commas/newlines/quotes and keep unique case-sensitive keys. Page contradicts automatic registration with later explicit registration requirement; verify project translation list and runtime use. Excel ANSI-only claim is outdated; verify exported UTF8 bytes.

External editor path/flags placeholders differ from debugger integration; most editor flags auto-detect since 4.5, Windows VSCode uses code.cmd. LSP/DAP need running Godot on the same project with separate default 6005/6006 ports, not an arbitrary language server.

PitchShift changes pitch independently of speed. Higher FFT size increases stability and latency, oversampling increases CPU demand and can crackle under load; profile and listen to transient-rich content at fixed mix conditions.

RemoteTransform2D pushes selected transform components to a relative-path target, defaulting to global coordinates. Target is cached and disappearance may require force_update_cache; validate lifecycle and avoid stale replacement targets.

BoxContainer layout follows child minimum-size changes; begin/end alignment reverses horizontally for RTL. Base orientation is mutable but HBox/VBox orientation cannot change. add_spacer adds a Control child and separation is a theme pixel constant.

SceneTree supplies root viewport, groups and pause state. Entry is parent-first, ready child-first and exit reverse order; process_priority can override normal traversal. Synchronous scene loading can stall and requires explicit background-loading workflow, not just a progress widget.

WebSocket state and IO only advance with poll, including CLOSING for graceful close. Client sample sleeps two seconds before send instead of checking OPEN, creating a race; use state-driven send and deadline. Server must check accept/send errors and bound peers/packet workloads, preserving text/binary distinction.

ImageFormatLoaderExtension registration is explicit during initialization and removal on teardown. Recognized extensions route decoding into supplied Image via FileAccess, flags and scale; respect Error return and test malformed files, not just registration.

Deprecated ParallaxLayer must be a child of ParallaxBackground; choose Parallax2D for new work. Runtime position/scale changes after entry are ignored. motion_mirroring repeats rather than reflects; zero disables an axis, and scaled textures need scaled repeat intervals. Only two instances are drawn, so a viewport larger than twice the interval produces gaps; use parent CanvasLayer offset rather than displacing the layer.

PinJoint3D constrains a point while allowing rotation, appropriate for a pendulum. Bias corrects positional separation, damping controls velocity relation, and positive impulse_clamp limits impulse. Read back parameters and verify actual backend motion rather than treating default values as a stability guarantee.

get_frames_available reports free buffer capacity, not queued audio; zero means full. Check push return values and can_push_buffer to prevent overflow. get_skips counts underruns and resets when playback starts. Batch versus per-frame push performance depends on language and must be measured; clear_buffer discards pending samples.

Named editor layouts persist dock positions, floating state and filesystem selections in global editor_layouts.cfg. A user layout named Default overrides the built-in default until removed. Detached script/shader windows require supported desktop platforms and disabled single-window mode. EditorSettings are shared across projects; changing display scale or navigation emulation requires respecting existing user preferences.

Profiler collection is explicitly started and has overhead; Autostart is not persisted across editor sessions. Compare inclusive and self times to distinguish expensive callees from callers. Frame time includes rendering, so fast scripts do not rule out render stalls. Built-in script profiling does not cover C#; use its supported external profiler. Manual tick differences are elapsed time samples, not evidence that every loop or branch needs optimization.

Visual shader parameters expose material values, global Project Settings values or per-instance values depending on qualifier. Explicit instance indices are limited to 0–15 and resolve clashes across materials on a node. Set parameter names and scope deliberately, and verify shared material versus per-instance behavior.

Avoid transcoding an existing lossy MP3 to another lossy format when no better source exists; choose WAV when simultaneous decode CPU cost dominates. Import beat metadata controls interactive music timing rather than sound effects. Loop offsets are seconds; looping playback does not emit finished at each file end, so completion-driven state machines need explicit loop handling.

Asset Library project-manager browsing installs standalone templates/demos/projects, while the in-project tab installs addons. Check engine compatibility, license and original source before installation, and inspect selected archive files and conflicts in Package Installer. Featured/community/testing labels describe support status, not local verification; test imported code before enabling editor tools.

iOS export requires macOS, Xcode and matching templates; Team ID is the ten-character code, not display name, and bundle ID must be valid and unique. Simulator supports Compatibility renderer; C# support is experimental with platform limits. Development folder linking replaces exported PCK and sets godot_path, with distinct project names to avoid signing issues. Verify selected Xcode SDK when xcode-select points to CommandLineTools. This Windows host cannot validate iOS deployment.

Outdated iOS-native plugin article describes .gdip plus static .a/.xcframework under res://ios/plugins, export activation and guarded Engine singleton access. Header/build flags must match export templates and device/simulator slices; debug/release binary naming and linked/embedded/system framework dependencies differ. This is an iOS native plugin workflow, not a generic GDExtension binary; verify current exporter implementation before prescribing flags or plist types. Not executable on this Windows host.

Outdated HTTPClient sample is not a ready recipe: SceneTree GDScript calls get_tree(), C# uses old idle_frame and omits required namespaces; standalone C# script invocation needs toolchain verification. Low-level client requires polling through resolving/connecting/request/body phases. Replace blocking sleeps with frame-driven state, add deadlines, byte limits, HTTP status and poll Error checks, decode expected charset, and test a controlled local server rather than an obsolete external PHP path. Android requires INTERNET permission.

Read prose and transforms overview diagram: distinguish item, parent, canvas, viewport, embedder and absolute-screen coordinates. CanvasLayer affects its own canvas; Camera2D changes viewport canvas transform; global canvas and stretch/window transforms add further stages. Diagram shows input callbacks and drawing use different spaces, with transform composition flowing item toward screen; test transformed parents, camera, embedded windows and SubViewport rather than assuming viewport coordinates are local.

Read image-based Object, RefCounted, Control, Node2D and Node3D trees. They illustrate broad Object/Node/CanvasItem and RefCounted/Resource relationships, but mix current classes with obsolete Godot 3 names including KinematicBody, SpatialPlayer, Pool arrays and ProximityGroup; missing current subclasses cannot justify capability exclusions. Use version-matched class reference and ClassDB inheritance for implementation, not these incomplete diagrams.

Variant transports and serializes built-in values; only Nil and Object variants can represent null. Arrays and dictionaries share mutations across references, so copy explicitly for isolation and synchronize cross-thread access. The page makes platform-size claims (24/20 bytes) that must be checked against the pinned native ABI rather than used for allocation or wire formats; master source links are not a version pin.

Select a supported XR environment blend mode: alpha requires transparent viewport, additive black background, opaque VR. Passthrough vendor extensions and permissions remain platform-dependent. Example switch_to_ar incorrectly reports success when neither AR blend mode exists, and switch_to_vr succeeds with no interface; validate initialized interface and chosen mode before mutating environment. shadow_to_opacity writes depth even where visually transparent, enabling occlusion/shadows but requiring headset visual acceptance.

Regex group zero is whole match; numeric/named capture lookups return -1 positions or empty string for absent/nonmatching groups, so empty text alone does not prove no match. names includes matched named groups and duplicate names select first matching capture. strings returns a copied PackedStringArray; modifying it does not rewrite the result or source.

Android JavaClassWrapper accesses constructors, static calls and Java interfaces without a custom Java plugin; retain callback implementation objects for their lifecycle. AndroidRuntime exposes Activity/context and wraps Godot Callable as Runnable for UI-thread calls. Gradle can include addon JAR/AAR files, which still need dependency/SDK verification. Guard singleton availability and API-level permissions; gallery sample uses old file URI/media scanner workflow, so verify modern scoped-storage behavior on device before reuse. Android device execution remains untested here.

Submission requires a working stated-version asset and matching license text; archives cannot rely on essential Git submodules. Addon namespace folders avoid collisions and should retain license/readme. export-ignore changes distributed contents, so validate the downloaded archive. Store settings include AI disclosure, version compatibility and uploaded files; platform review rules must be rechecked if actually publishing. Public store submission is outside this task.

OpenXRInteractionProfile stores suggested bindings and modifiers for a device interaction-profile path, not a guarantee of runtime input availability. Enumerate bounded binding/modifier indices and configure action bindings per supported profile; verify runtime-selected profiles and actual device controls on headset.

Prefer resource loading for imported packaged textures; filesystem image loading may fail after export unless source bytes or Image resources are included. get_image returns a copy. Initialize before update and preserve dimensions, format and mipmap configuration; set_image reallocates when parameters change. set_size_override changes reported texture size and must not be assumed to resample pixels without source verification. Hardware limits need target-specific checks.

Mix C# and GDScript through node composition and Variant-compatible fields, Call/Get/Set and Connect; cross-language script inheritance is unsupported. C# script class must match filename, derive GodotObject and be included in a built project. Preserve language-specific property/method/signal casing and validate argument marshaling; the page claim that missing C# Call arguments fail silently should be tested via errors and behavior rather than adopted as error handling.

Register custom Logger via OS.add_logger and distinguish engine/script/shader errors from stderr messages. Both virtual callbacks may run concurrently on worker threads, so protect bounded collection and defer scene-tree work. Do not print/push_error inside logger callbacks because recursive logging is unsupported. Automatic backtraces omit variables and default release stacks; explicit stack tracking has overhead. Failure detection should assert captured errors rather than treating stdout or process startup as success.

One-click deploy needs a runnable preset and complete platform setup; only one runnable preset per platform is active. Android discovery follows authorized adb devices; iOS needs pairing/provisioning and Mac tools; desktop remote deployment uses configured SSH. Web serves localhost by default; remote threaded builds need secure context and correct headers, and stale service-worker caches can show the wrong project. Do not change host binding, router forwarding or TLS trust as an implicit development step.

FogMaterial controls FogVolume scattering, density and emission; emission does not illuminate other objects. Negative density subtracts fog, while densities strictly between -0.001 and 0.001 quantize to zero for volumes, not global fog. Static density_texture differs from animated fog shaders; high density can create undersampling stripes. Confirm supported volumetric renderer and evaluate temporal/visual artifacts on a rendered target.

Query session support asynchronously, connect started/failed/ended handlers, and enable viewport XR only after session_started. Compatibility renderer and multiview-capable browser/device are required. Sample says button_pressed signal although Button uses pressed; required local-floor prevents optional local fallback unless feature policy is adjusted. WebXR input names differ from OpenXR primary/secondary conventions. Verify enter/fail/end cleanup on browser and headset.

Tile source coordinates IDs and alternative IDs are distinct from enumeration indices. Iterate count/index APIs and query existence; atlas base alternative zero counts in alternatives, absent tile may return -1 count. A source belongs to only one TileSet: adding it to a second removes it from the first, so duplicate deliberately for independent assets and verify both saved TileSets after mutation.

ThemeDB exposes engine and project themes plus fallback values used only when Control has no other value. Project gui/theme/custom overrides default appearance; global fallback_font is not a substitute for resolving a control theme font. fallback_changed can refresh custom controls. Verify actual resolved theme items and saved resource reload rather than only assigning a Theme property.

GLTFMesh holds ImporterMesh, material overrides, original name and copied blend-weight array. Assign modified blend_weights back rather than editing a returned copy. Stateless GLTFDocumentExtension implementations can store per-mesh data under their own names using additional_data; missing data returns null and namespace need not match glTF extension JSON names. Verify persistence/export separately from this in-memory state.

ObjectDB snapshots compare class counts, node trees, orphan nodes and inbound/outbound references; RefCounted view separates native and ObjectDB references and detected cycles. Snapshot files in user://objectdb_snapshots are portable. It does not account for all native/external memory, so correlate repeated scene lifecycle snapshots with total memory measurements rather than treating one object count as a leak. Diff A/B direction and captured time matter for before/after evidence.

AspectRatioContainer ratio is width divided by height. Fit preserves aspect inside bounds; cover may extend outside and requires clip_contents when cropping is intended. Width-controls-height and height-controls-width use different layout constraints. Verify resized child rectangles and minimum sizes after layout completes instead of manually fighting container-owned transforms.

Access EditorResourcePreview through EditorInterface, not direct instantiation. Queued callbacks receive path, preview, thumbnail and userdata; callback still runs with null preview on failure. Track request identity/lifetime so obsolete async previews cannot overwrite current selection. Pair custom preview generator registration with removal, and invalidate cached previews after changed resources.

Cubic Bezier uses endpoint-relative control handles; uniform parameter t is not uniform world speed. Baked distance sampling approximates constant-speed traversal and trades bake interval against error; tessellation controls drawing curvature tolerance. The tutorial says curve interpolates all four points, but interior controls shape the curve rather than guaranteed points on it. Integrate distance as speed*delta, clamp or wrap at endpoints, and test transformed Path2D/Path3D instead of copying unbounded t examples.

WebRTC uses signaling for SDP/ICE and data channels for transport; native platforms require external webrtc-native GDExtension while Web supplies browser implementation. Same-process examples are handshake teaching aids, not NAT/TURN or adversarial tests. Replace fixed one-second send delays with STATE_OPEN and error/deadline checks, bound packet draining, unregister signaling peers on teardown, and test actual separate processes/devices including relay fallback.

Topic links reveal research areas including WebRTC, threading, extension tutorials and migration guides, all already within source inventory rather than external read claims.

OmniLight range is a radius unaffected by node/parent scale; attenuation can make effective brightness far smaller than range. Mobile and Compatibility per-mesh light limits can cause flicker, and shader-deformed mesh bounds need adequate cull margin for light intersection. Cubemap shadows trade quality against dual-paraboloid cost. Measure on the actual renderer and verify lighting visually, not just property assignment.

Script templates are scoped globally or under a project search path and require case-sensitive node-type folders; ancestor-type templates are also offered. Metadata controls default/name/description/indentation and placeholders are replaced on script creation. .gdignore prevents Godot import but does not exclude C# files from MSBuild; add a project compile exclusion. Prefer project-local templates over implicit global edits and parse/build the generated script, not the template containing placeholders.

PCKPacker start/add/flush each return Error and must be checked. Adds write bytes immediately; flush writes directory and closes pack, so explicitly finish before loading/readback. Resource target paths differ from source filesystem paths; add_file_removal creates patch removals. C# needs disposal. Test mounted bytes and removal precedence using fresh unique paths, and do not mistake a custom raw pack for the import/export resource pipeline.

Expression is separate from GDScript and needs parse Error plus has_execute_failed checks; null result alone cannot distinguish legitimate null from failure. Variable names/values are parallel arrays and case-sensitive. Bound base_instance exposes script members/methods; avoid executing untrusted network expressions against gameplay objects. GlobalScope built-ins require all arguments even where API defaults exist. Integer division and remainder behavior affect authored formulas.

Visual shader derivative node is available only in fragment/light stages, with scalar/vector variants and x/y/fwidth-style sum functions. Default lets driver select precision; fine/coarse tradeoffs require rendered measurement and visual comparison. Compatibility ignores precision setting, so do not claim it changes that renderer or treat successful graph resource creation as shader compilation.

Deprecated ParallaxBackground should be replaced with Parallax2D for new tasks. Legacy child motion uses base offsets/scales and camera-derived scroll_offset, with explicit manual scrolling when no Camera2D. Each CanvasLayer background targets one viewport, so split-screen requires independent instances. Verify zoom-ignore and valid begin/end scroll limits across camera motion rather than sharing one background node.

CameraServer enumerates external camera feeds; built-in implementations cover Linux, Android, macOS and iOS, not Windows. Connect feeds-updated before enabling monitoring and stop monitoring when unused due to performance cost. Signal IDs and get_feed enumeration indices must not be conflated; handle hot removal and feed format variants. iOS requires camera module export setting and device permissions; no Windows camera capture pass is inferred from an empty feed list.

Desktop Android export needs configured JDK and SDK paths plus pinned build tools/platform/NDK as applicable; Android editor supplies its own runtime tools. Distinguish prebuilt APK and Gradle AAB workflows, C# experimental limits, and debug versus release signing. Package/key mismatch can block installation but uninstalling an existing app destroys data, so use an isolated package or explicit migration choice. Launcher icon safe zones and density sizes need device checks. Environment keystore overrides must stay out of logs; current store target requirements require fresh verification at actual delivery.

Debug overlays expose collision, paths, navigation and avoidance, while Remote scene dock inspects live node state. Scene/script synchronization and network filesystem affect deployed debug runs, not persisted authored resources. Multi-instance main arguments apply even when multi-instance mode is disabled; -- separates user arguments, and repeated separators can alter per-instance composition. Distinguish stored source breakpoint keyword from editor-local gutter state; assert reproduction and persisted fix beyond inspecting a live value.

Asset Library submission points at a repository commit and requires license consistency, engine-version compatibility and functional archive contents. Essential submodules are absent from provider ZIP downloads; addons must retain namespaced files, license and readme. Download commit and icon raw URL are separate from repository page URL. This older library supports different submission/version/media mechanisms from Asset Store, so do not conflate them. Publication remains outside this task.

BoneAttachment3D follows or overrides a named/indexed Skeleton3D bone, using parent skeleton or explicitly enabled external path. get_skeleton may return null. Legacy override interrupts skeleton updates through signals and can conflict with SkeletonModifier3D, so prefer deliberate ordering and verify final pose after modifiers. Test invalid/reimported bone names, attachment transforms and follow/override behavior rather than only saved NodePaths.

Registered XR interface does not imply runtime support or successful initialization. OpenXR needs startup project settings and checks is_initialized; other interfaces normally initialize explicitly. Tracked camera/controllers belong under XROrigin3D and physical poses overwrite editor staging transforms. Keep one primary output interface and avoid repeated initialization on scene swaps. Renderer/postprocess stereo compatibility, HMD-controlled frame timing and physics cadence require actual headset testing; generic Mobile recommendation is not a measured budget.

StreamPeerTLS wraps an underlying stream and validates certificate hostname using common_name and TLSOptions client defaults. Server accepts with server options. Track handshaking, connected, generic error and hostname-mismatch states with deadlines; poll immediately before querying available bytes. Unsafe client options are explicit trust changes, not a standard repair for failed verification. Test trusted success, wrong hostname, failed trust and clean disconnect.

AnimationLibrary stores named Animation resources; add returns Error, missing get returns null and logs an error, so query has_animation for expected absence. Change/add/remove/rename signals identify keys and relay Animation Resource changes. Verify resource reload with track values and player resolution after renaming, not only list count or in-memory callbacks.

MultiplayerSpawner replicates authority additions of configured scenes as direct children of spawn_path. Custom spawn_function runs on all peers and must return an unattached Node; spawner adds it automatically. spawned/despawned signals run only on remote peers, so authority lifecycle code needs a separate path. Limit zero is unlimited and clear_spawnable_scenes does not despawn existing nodes. Validate data/authority, join-late state and teardown with actual separate peers.

AESContext supports raw ECB/CBC with 16/32-byte keys, CBC 16-byte IV and block-aligned update buffers; start Error and finish lifecycle require checks. C# sample incorrectly selects ECB for CBC sections and uses array reference equality in Debug.Assert; compare byte contents and actual CBC modes. Roundtrip alone does not establish authentication or safe save/network design; choose appropriate data integrity policy rather than copy fixed key/IV samples as production encryption.

Container owns child layout and handles SORT_CHILDREN immediately; queue_sort requests deferred rearrangement, so verify geometry after layout. fit_child_in_rect supports custom containers. Allowed-size-flag overrides restrict Inspector choices only and do not enforce runtime flag legality. Accessibility regions require descriptive accessibility_name and screen-reader acceptance beyond layout assertions.

Debugger separates stack/evaluator/errors from script, visual and network profiling. @tool breakpoints are unsupported; use logging and editor-specific diagnostics. Visual Profiler measures rendering CPU/GPU only, so combine with script/physics profiler and fixed viewport size; Compatibility on macOS is unsupported. Network bandwidth meter ignores multiplayer compression. Runtime changes and graphs are session evidence; record reproducible failures and saved-state fixes separately.

Create PropertyTweener via Tween.tween_property, never directly. from_current captures current value at creation, not necessarily at delayed start; from sets explicit baseline and as_relative changes final target into a displacement. Target freeing automatically ends the tweener. Custom interpolator receives already-eased progress and can overshoot. Test final values, delayed baseline, cancellation and target lifetime; successful completion does not prove intended motion.

AudioStreamGenerator needs a playback producer and continuous refills; the sine example only fills once and is not a complete sustained-audio recipe. Buffer duration trades latency against underruns and production cost. Custom/output/input mix rate modes must match sample data; generator does not resample input automatically. Derive phase increment from effective rate, check push capacity/results, measure skips and listen for clicks; lower GDScript sample rates are conditional quality/performance choices, not a pass guarantee.

Autoload provides persistent Node services, not enforced singleton uniqueness or the only way to share state. Initialization follows ordered autoload entries; C# Enable checkbox does not create a static Instance automatically. Tutorial root.get_child(-1) from autoload _ready assumes current scene already exists and needs runtime verification. Custom scene switch frees before validating/loading replacement, risking loss on failure; load/validate first, defer safely and update SceneTree.current_scene. Keep autoload lifetime intact and test independent scenes, duplicate requests and invalid target recovery.

OpenXR metadata registers top-level paths, profiles then IO bindings with action types; extension availability filters unsupported profile/binding entries from action maps. Separate IO/profile rename registration supports older action-map migration. Device tracker creation follows actual OpenXR binding, not merely metadata registration. This API mainly serves XR core/extensions/action-map editor; ordinary gameplay should consume supported tracker/action state and require headset tests.

CanvasItemMaterial selects blend and light modes; premultiplied-alpha assets need matching premult blend to avoid fringes. Use ShaderMaterial for custom logic. Spritesheet properties affect only GPU/CPU 2D particles, require particles_animation and positive animation speed, and do not animate arbitrary sprites. Verify material sharing, light response and atlas frames on rendered output.

Bone2D rest is parent-relative and apply_rest resets local transform; set rest per bone for procedural skeletons. Gizmo bone angle differs from node rotation, and automatic length/angle uses first Bone2D child, warning on leaf bones. get_skeleton_rest prose ambiguously describes parent-relative result despite method name; check source before global-rest conversions. Assert pose, skin deformation and saved rest reload rather than merely creating bone nodes.

XR composition layers improve UI clarity but can be headset-only and fall back to regular geometry on unsupported runtimes. Place layer under XROrigin3D, configure transparent SubViewport/update mode, and map ray UV to viewport pixels with correct local-input semantics. Example drops press state on ray exit without sending release, risking stuck GUI interaction; handle release on exit/controller loss and initial hover motion. Hole punching plus negative sort order restores foreground occlusion; verify in headset and spectator separately.

Material next_pass renders geometry again but does not guarantee immediate ordering after the source pass. Spatial material render_priority cannot override transparent-versus-opaque pipeline ordering or all opaque mesh sorting; use correct transparency/depth strategy and measure extra passes. Custom Material virtuals are override-only and need shader mode/RID implementations. Native shader inspection is editor-only and reveals generated variants, useful for compilation diagnosis rather than runtime gameplay API.

PhysicsTestMotionResult2D separates attached Object/instance ID from collider RID and local/collider shape indices. Read collision-only fields only when body_test_motion reports collision. Global collision point, normal, overlap depth and safe/unsafe motion fractions distinguish initial penetration from swept motion; travel/remainder describe displacement, not velocity. Verify query does not itself move the body and test hit/miss/overlap with actual physics frames.
