SubViewport needs both dimensions >=2 and a displayed ViewportTexture or SubViewportContainer; it creates no window. Standalone input must be forwarded or propagated through the container. Container stretch owns size. Distinguish texture visibility update gating from parent visibility, use UPDATE_ONCE and verify transition to disabled after rendering; CLEAR_MODE_ONCE is separate and 2D-oriented. Test actual frame output, input coordinates and resize, not node existence.

Custom shell must include exported GODOT_URL and GODOT_CONFIG placeholders and select a canvas. startGame loads/initializes/preloads pack and returns a Promise; catch rejection and display recoverable loading errors. start alone does not preload pack; init/preload may run concurrently before start. Keep unloadAfterInit false only for intentional multiple-instance reuse and measure memory. Progress total can be zero, so use indeterminate UI. Verify canvas resize, user-gesture fullscreen, locale, stdout/stderr callbacks and deployed dependency URLs in a browser; do not count native tests as Web acceptance.

HeightMapShape3D is centered fixed XZ grid with one-unit spacing and Y heights; supports NAN holes but not overhangs/caves, which need separate collision. Set dimensions before assigning width*depth samples and reassign getter-copy arrays. Image import accepts RF/RH/R8 and remaps [0,1] to height bounds; EXR/HDR 16/32-bit avoids 8-bit terracing. GodotPhysics3D requires uniform scaling with inverse Y sample compensation and cannot scale dynamic bodies; Jolt differences require backend-specific behavior tests. Sample unqualified update_map_data_from_image is valid only on a matching receiver, so recipes must invoke the shape explicitly. Compare rendered terrain and collision at edges, holes and scale.

Export requires exact-version templates, preset and platform SDKs; PCK/ZIP alone is not a runnable build. Select scenes/resources include dependencies but dynamically selected assets and raw JSON/CSV need deliberate filters; hidden files excluded. Keep export_presets tracked and credentials private. Dedicated server replaces visuals so explicitly retain needed geometry/data. Output paths are project-relative, not shell working-directory-relative; verify moved release independently of editor/import cache. Page universal all-PC S3TC claim is overbroad and extension list has legacy Web/iOS ZIP naming: verify selected platform current CLI behavior. ICU data needed for CJK and listed complex scripts/emojis. ZIP pack requires explicit --main-pack rather than assumed automatic loading.

OpenXR render-model availability is runtime-dependent; query extension is_active and provide fallback controllers. Manager requires XROrigin ancestor and Any/None modes direct parenting; hand modes and make_local_to_pose must match controller pose. Tracking/hand attribution does not prove a controller is held. Collision hand physics priority must follow origin movement; top-level/sync disabled sample sets orientation directly and only sweeps translation, so test rotation clipping too. Tutorial switches tracker/target terminology and plural changes signal spelling: verify class binding before implementing. Runtime-owned render-model RIDs must not be destroyed outside owning extension logic. Headset tracking, disconnect/reconnect and hand/pose offset acceptance require actual hardware and remain untested here.

Resource packs can execute scripts and override existing paths by default: define trusted publisher/mod policy, verify signed bytes before mounting when appropriate, and use replace_files=false or namespaces for additive content. Delta patches require exact base archive bytes and identical runtime mount order; re-exported equivalent content may differ. Measure cumulative decode costs and preserve release archives/hashes. Mount early before cached/preloaded resources, check boolean then typed load/instantiate and verify patched behavior after restart. C# assembly loading is additional executable-code lifecycle and path/compatibility concern; bare Assembly.LoadFile relative sample needs resolved absolute path. Compression changes/reimport must target generated cache safely only after verified project path; not indiscriminate user directory cleanup.

WAV source does not imply uncompressed runtime PCM: default import mode is lossy QOA. Choose PCM for lowest decode CPU/highest memory, IMA ADPCM only when no seeking and forward-only loops suffice, QOA for quality/memory compromise; measure actual imported bytes and voices. Loop boundaries are samples not seconds and looping never emits finished at file end. Peak normalization to 0dB is not loudness matching; leave mixer headroom. Trim changes timing and applies 500-sample fades. Mono/rate reduction and 8-bit affect quality; compare audible result and latency. force/max_rate is boolean despite prose greater-than-zero wording.

AnimationNodeAnimation selects an AnimationPlayer animation within AnimationTree and has one output. Custom timeline independently changes offset, loop and length; stretch_time_scale fits a cycle, while false preserves original rate. advance_on_start processes but does not draw first frame, so verify callbacks/root motion at entry. Custom loop override cannot alone enable original track interpolation loop wrap on a non-looping Animation; duplicate shared resource before modifying loop settings and test phase matching, reverse direction, serialization and reload.

Godot4 native binaries support headless; use export template for deployment and editor for export. Dedicated_server feature forces headless but does not establish network authority or connection readiness. Strip Visuals preserves supported placeholder references; Keep image pixels used to generate collision; Remove breaks retained scene references and requires separate optional loading. Documentation resource tree includes audio placeholder while warning says audio stripping unsupported, so verify actual class/backend before claiming support. Test exported server starts from moved folder, binds peer, handles reconnect/shutdown and preserves physics/data with visuals removed. Headless also used for tools/tests: explicit -- --server user argument avoids unintentionally launching network server for every headless command.

XRNode3D transforms updated by XRServer and require XROrigin child hierarchy; tracker and pose availability discovered at runtime rather than assumed from standard names. Distinguish registered active pose from current tracking data; react to tracking_changed, hide or disable interactions on loss with show_when_tracked and restore on reacquisition. Physics interpolation default disabled avoids extra tracking lag. Haptic action must exist and clamp amplitude 0..1, use seconds for duration/delay and zero frequency for runtime default; headset tests required.

ProgressBar derives Range, so percentage must use configured min/max rather than assume raw value 0..100. Horizontal fill follows RTL language direction; test both directions and vertical modes. Unknown progress uses indeterminate which hides numeric fill; editor preview pause does not imply runtime stopped. Theme background/fill StyleBoxes, font and text/outline colors require saved Theme plus reload/render evidence. MSDF outline needs pixel range >= twice outline size to avoid clipping; inspect actual fonts, DPI and localization.

Embedded game always separate process. Pause halts idle/physics but leaves render/input for inspection; stepping and speed controls alter physics tick rate/max steps, so not equivalent to an uninstrumented performance baseline. Remote Inspector edits are transient; persist Local scene changes and save with synchronize enabled, then rerun to verify. Fixed/aspect/stretch embedding sizing differs from export behavior; fullscreen/window modes require standalone tests. Only first multi-instance embedded. Camera override invisible to game scripts can mislead camera-dependent diagnostics and editor-driven override uses local network jitter. Confirm input interaction mode, unmute and reset speed/camera when reproducing gameplay.

Experimental OpenXR spatial entity trackers are extension-managed TRACKER_ANCHOR objects, with stopped/paused/tracking states distinct from generic tracker presence. Default paused means not yet usable tracked geometry. Spatial context/entity RIDs and extension next-chain structure must stay associated with owning runtime; latest add_next becomes chain head until removed. Read-only consumers should handle tracking-state changes and unsupported extensions, not manufacture valid anchors by assigning arbitrary RIDs. Signal lacks description, so verify emitted enum and lifecycle in pinned binding before recipes; device acceptance remains untested.

JavaScriptBridge wraps global interfaces, constructors and callback objects. Retain callback refs, accept exactly one Array argument, detach DOM listeners on node teardown and handle promise rejection/lifetime. Warning mistakenly says callbacks created with get_interface rather than create_callback. Guard web plus actual interface availability because custom templates may disable bridge; web feature alone does not prove support. Null eval can mean unsupported return type or unavailable bridge, not successful operation. Pin bundled JS dependencies instead of mutable CDN latest; avoid evaluating untrusted text. Permission/download/fullscreen actions need user gesture and real browser tests. Generic C# bridge syntax does not establish C# Web export support.

TileMapPattern stores source/atlas/alternative identifiers in nonnegative local coordinates from origin; size is cell extent, not used-cell count. Use has_cell/get_used_cells to distinguish empty pattern and missing cells. remove_cell update_size explicitly controls recomputed bounds. Prefer TileMapLayer workflow rather than deprecated TileMap tutorial cross-link; map_pattern handles half-offset coordinate mapping so pasting is not always simple origin+offset. Verify identifiers exist in destination TileSet and persisted pattern reload plus pasted cells/collisions, including alternate tiles.

EditorFileSystem is EditorInterface-owned singleton, not instantiated. File type is resource class not extension. update_file registers metadata but does not import; reimport files after source/.import edits, scan when newly created/type changed. Import blocks caller while pumping main loop timers/process, so plugin requires importing/scanning guards and queued/coalesced requests to prevent reentrancy. Wait relevant import/filesystem/class-cache signals with deadline before using generated files; verify saved resource state survives editor restart and disconnect signals on plugin disable.

VoxelGI requires Forward+, baked static geometry and prepared lights; can bake exported procedural levels once geometry ready. Defer bake after generated nodes ready and measure actual bake duration rather than assume 5-20s. Probe size >=1 each axis and size/subdiv trade cell precision against GPU cost; quality/half resolution and hide-probe fallback require visual/performance tests. Thick closed walls/temporary static blocker geometry reduce leaks. Bake exposure ignores auto-exposure and can cause banding/clipping; preserve data resource and verify reload plus dynamic receivers. Static baked geometry changes require rebake, not claimed automatic runtime updates.

PhysicalSkyMaterial analytic Preetham model supports one sun from first DirectionalLight3D; order/light changes must be deliberate and visually verified. Resource drives Sky, not direct material on meshes. Night texture adds rather than replacing daytime sky, so overly bright stars can show at noon. Rayleigh/Mie coefficients/colors, directional eccentricity, turbidity and disk size shape atmosphere; distinguish artistic tint from physical assumptions and actual light/GI exposure. Debanding introduces noise; inspect gradients under target renderer/output and keep fixed exposure for comparison. Save material/sky/environment, reload and test dusk/noon plus sun ordering.

UDPServer must poll regularly and check listen/poll/send errors, accept null safely, drain bounded packet/connection budgets and retain accepted PacketPeerUDP references. New address/port datagram creates pending connection, not authenticated/reliable session. Default pending cap16 and zero blocks new peers; stop closes all accepted sockets without remote notification, so application protocol needs deadlines/heartbeat/session expiry. Sample client sends every frame until reply with no rate/deadline; add bounded retry/backoff and loopback binding for tests. Test first packet, multiple peers, cap, port conflict and silent shutdown, not just is_listening.

Marked outdated Web shell API must be verified against pinned platform/web/js engine/config sources before copy. Load/init/preload/start Promise sequencing, explicit executable/mainPack and DOM canvas; preload binary buffers require filesystem destination before start, copyToFS creates virtual file not durable browser storage. Resize policies0/1/2 own canvas sizing differently. onExit and requestQuit cannot recover crashed/hung engine; external watchdog/error UI needed. Progress zero total requires indeterminate UI. Variadic print callbacks and onExecute are Web shell hooks, not desktop process launch. isWebGLAvailable default1 may not satisfy Godot4 WebGL2 requirement; use current feature detection rather than accept default success.

GradientTexture2D samples gradient per generated pixel, so dimensions control fidelity and memory rather than exact analytic copy. fill_from/to are UV coordinates; fill modes linear/radial/square/conic and repeat/mirror differ from texture sampler repeat. use_hdr creates RGBAF allowing overbright values while RGBA8 clamps; HDR texture does not itself enable HDR display output. Test pixel values after render/resource update and saved reload plus actual glow with correctly configured viewport/environment. Shared gradient resources require duplication for per-instance edits.

Timer starts only inside SceneTree; start resets countdown but does not clear paused. Autostart resets false on tree entry and does not run in editor. one_shot controls recurrence; stop does not emit timeout. Choose physics vs idle tick and time-scale policy deliberately; ignore_time_scale is not a substitute for process-mode pause handling. Frame-limited processing makes <~0.05s timers unreliable and unsuitable for high-frequency scheduling/network clocks. Test timeout count, restart, pause/unpause, scene teardown and timescale; use monotonic wall time for deadlines and bounded accumulator for repeated simulation events.

SceneTree default MainLoop provides lifecycle; custom --script/MainLoop replacement must return bool from process/physics methods, true quits. Ordinary Node process returns void, so do not conflate standalone script contracts. C# example private _Finalize fails to override virtual lifecycle and needs public override void signature plus compiled shutdown evidence. Physics/idle deltas may be capped/scaled/smoothed and fixed-FPS/movie mode not wall time; use monotonic ticks for performance/network deadlines. Mobile pause notification has brief iOS completion window, so save small prepared state and recover interrupted write. OS memory/crash/about/IME notifications platform-conditioned and not universal guarantees.

Gettext PO/MO supports contextual and plural translations, one locale per file; generated POT must include all selected scenes/scripts and be regenerated with source changes. GDScript extraction only evaluates constant strings, with NO_TRANSLATE and TRANSLATORS comments; dynamic/custom formats require maintained catalogs or EditorTranslationParserPlugin. msgmerge message file precedes template and fuzzy entries are ignored until updated; validate PO with msgfmt and preserve editable PO when compiling MO. Register translations and verify locale header, contexts, plurals, fonts/RTL and exported reload. These GDScript extraction rules do not promise C# extraction. Resolve repeated Updating sections into one recipe.

GraphFrame organizes explicitly attached GraphElements within GraphEdit; visual enclosure alone does not establish model relationship. Autoshrink includes attached elements with margin and movement moves all attachments, frame stays behind graph connection/elements. Build grouping/ungrouping using GraphEdit attachment APIs and application graph IDs, record UndoRedo plus persistence, and test autoshrink/manual sizing/movement and selection. Titlebar HBox exposes Label plus custom controls; verify mouse filtering, drag margin and cleanup. Theme panel/titlebar selected states differ and require actual UI acceptance.

GLTFLight represents KHR_lights_punctual with point/spot/directional types, linear-space color converted to/from Light3D sRGB, and physical intensity units varying by type. Infinite glTF range clamps to4096 in Godot; spotlight inner<=outer angle influences attenuation, so roundtrip is not automatically identical. Use to/from dictionary/node and test type/color/cone/range under configured physical light-unit mode, radians vs Godot degrees verified in source. Additional-data methods undocumented and not guaranteed emitted extension payload; use GLTFDocumentExtension ownership and explicit serialization checks.

Log stdout/stderr flags affect custom loggers; release stdout buffering differs from always-flushed stderr, so enable flush-on-print deliberately for server collectors and measure overhead. File logs rotate; sample blindly indexing get_files_at[-1] can fail empty dir or select wrong/current file, so filter rotated candidates and deterministic timestamps, bound reads and handle errors. Native crash backtrace needs matching symbols and cannot be consumed by crashed scripts until later session; GDScript release call stacks separate setting. Custom logger register early but cannot capture engine startup, is invoked on concurrent threads, and must not recursively print/error; use bounded synchronized queue, redaction and clean unregister.

GPUParticlesCollisionSDF3D bake is editor-only API; exported games can load prebaked Texture3D, not invoke a nonexistent bake method. Visible meshes within bounds filtered by visual bake-mask layers, independent of GI mode; distinct from runtime particle collision mask. Particle material needs rigid/hide collision and affects GPU not CPU particles or physics bodies. Resolution requires rebake and increases VRAM/storage/bake cost; minimize bounds and inspect actual collisions. SDF hollow interiors and high-speed tunneling may need thickness; test speed/movement and exported reload plus renderer support. Layer helpers use1..32, bitmask uses shifts.

PhysicsTestMotionResult3D supports multiple contacts with deepest index0 default; guard index<collision_count and successful body_test_motion before collision-only fields. Object instance ID differs from server RID and body/local shape indices. Global point/normal/depth and collider velocity diagnose overlap versus swept hit; safe/unsafe motion fractions0..1 and travel/remainder describe motion, not automatic body update or velocity. Test no-hit, initial penetration, multi-shape contacts and query nonmovement across actual physics frames and selected backend.

Experimental TwoBoneIK rotates exactly two Bone2D joints using lengths/law of cosines; choose lighter solver for two-segment limb, FABRIK for longer chain. Configure joint paths or skeleton bone indices and target coordinate hierarchy; getters called bone2d_node return NodePath despite prose node wording.
